notes.title: Update v0.5.1
notes.content:
Update focused on polishing procedural generation and increasing variety (3 new seasons). Changes and improvements to presentation and balance (objects, effects, sprites, particles, etc.) are also included.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011351/447b52f69f21009d35421ca038d33a0f549bebc3.png

New Additions!

Seasons
There are 3 new seasons that modify the lands of Dungeon World and bring unseen creatures:

 Tropical: Trees will appear in deserts and seas; stay away from jellyfish, they explode on minimum contact.
 Cloudy: The sea will fill with clouds in deep areas; chase frogs to travel easily between floors.
 Flowery: Mountains will give way to flowered trees; beware of carnivorous plants, they grow with each bite.

Seed for procedural generation
From now on, you'll be able to set a seed for the world generation of each game, allowing you to share and reproduce the terrain formation and initial NPC placement.
Note: The seed is written below the minimap in the status menu; worlds prior to this version (0.5.1) do not have a record of the seed used.

Cheat: Terrain
A new cheat available for those who have completed the library: seasons will produce extreme changes, drastically transforming the landscape, to points where it can be difficult to navigate... For experienced players only!

Changes and Corrections

 The pickaxe can now also create abysses.
 When you go to pick up an item with a full inventory, you will be informed what type of item it is.
 The fish from the rainy season were changed to springs; drinking from them will rejuvenate you a bit.
 You can now push temples with the leaf.
 Added Steam's virtual keyboard support when playing with a controller.
 The edges of the middle plane are now clouds.
 The functionality of particles was corrected so they no longer disappear abruptly.
 The dragon orb's sprite was changed.


Thank you for your interest in Dungeon World, and I hope you enjoy the additions in this new version!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011351/4d157313129ac247d86759dfbacac6aa4c908929.gif

notes.title: Update v0.5.0
notes.content:
Almost a year into Early Access, Dungeon World already features a good variety of monsters and items... but adventures also need a story: finally, unlockable characters with micro-stories are here, offering a first approach to the lore after saving these withered lands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011351/68f25b5703465591db01f5eb4007fa4c2d079a31.gif

New Stories

Wandering Spirits
Some spirits wander the lands of Dungeon World with a wish that still ties them to the mortal realm. If you manage to gather the items they request, their stories will inspire the avatar with a new appearance, allowing you to start new runs with different items and unseen animations. These spirits are unique—meaning the items you give them will carry over if you meet them in other worlds, letting you preserve progress and unlock rewards across multiple runs.

To change your appearance or check all collected spirits, head to the mirror located in the Hub.

After the Final Day...
If you overcome the apocalypse and defeat the being that shaped the world, you should seek out the prophet—now that his mission is complete, he can finally rest and offer you a valuable gift.

Changes and Fixes

 New music theme plays near wandering spirits.
 Some new tips added in the player milestone menu.
 Signpost text now always appears on the minimap without needing to have a map in your inventory.
 The telescope now shows how many days have passed in a run.
 Fixed a bug that caused the credits scene to trigger multiple times at the end of a run.


Steam

 5 new achievements added to the Steam profile.
 Cloud saves are now cross-platform (PC / Steam Deck).

Early Access
Dungeon World will receive its final version (1.0.0) by the end of 2025. I believe the game is quite complete and balanced—I just want to add a bit more variety and polish some details before calling it done.

The Steam Early Access FAQ has been updated on the store page.

Roadmap
I plan to release the final Dungeon World updates during the second half of 2025. There will be at least two more updates before the final 1.0.0, one of which will be like this one (v0.6.0), where I will revise the roadmap to clarify the current state of development.

Upcoming content, ordered by priority:

 Seed management for procedural generation.
 More seasons (3).
 Post-game content, likely in the sky and underground.
 More unlockable characters (3).
 Filling in lore gaps.
 More cheats.
 Technical refinements.


As for online features, they will likely be dropped for version 1.0.0 due to a lack of a large enough community to justify the implementation. However, the design is well-developed, and I may revisit it in a future update—or adapt it into a lighter version without requiring a server.

Thanks for your interest in Dungeon World—I hope you enjoy the new content in this update!

notes.title: Update v0.4.2
notes.content:
New Monsters

Thief
A weak creature that appears near shrines when you make deals with the Fairy Queen. It will steal your items from a safe distance and then run away—chase it down and kill it to get your items back!

Nest
After the first year (or through a secret interaction), you will see monster nests in the middle plane: if you are within their range, they will order nearby monsters to attack you... and if there are none, they will spawn them! The monster that appears depends on the last important day (Soul, World, or Magic), and you can add it to your party if you bring an item it likes!

New Group Members

Skeleton
An extremely resilient skeleton. However, since it is not alive, it cannot be healed in any way. Find it in a monster nest after the Soul Day.

Slime
Thanks to its moist body, it grants the party immunity to fire and terrain damage (lava, swamp, etc.). Find it in a monster nest after the World Day.

Thief
If you have this mischievous monster in your party, sometimes it will steal the item an enemy is carrying just by attacking them. Find it in a monster nest after the Magic Day.

Quality of Life Changes

Units that take damage now have a small animation and "throw into the air" a number to indicate how much damage they received.
Old saves will no longer be locked and can be updated to include future version changes (mainly unique spawns at the beginning of the game and hero actions with certain units).


General Balance

The bomb now destroys mountains and walls up to 4 tiles away (damage and fire still apply up to 2 tiles).
Frozen season ice no longer breaks when stepped on, only when bombs are used.
Skeletons now leave an empty corpse when they die.
The attack range of the towers has been increased; it is now 3 spaces.


Bug Fixes

When upgrading HP, hearts would stop displaying after 8 (visual issue—your actual HP was working correctly). This has now been fixed for the maximum number of hearts (12).
The player could not attack magic spiders or magic wyrms. This has been fixed.
Minor bugs that caused cutscenes and some menus to overlap have been fixed.
Fixed a bug where your heir would gain more HP than you had.
Fixed a bug where units would sometimes overlap and/or you couldn't interact with them.


Thank you for your interest in Dungeon World! I hope you enjoy the new additions in this version!

notes.title: Update v0.4.1
notes.content:
New Monster - Werewolf
A creature that appears during the nights of the mid-plane and spawns on the world-day near caves. It turns merchants into monsters like itself and leaps onto its prey to chase them. Luckily, it’s not very strong, but it can surprise the unwary or turn an entire community into nocturnal beasts.

New Item - Cursed Fang
Part of a monster cursed by the creator, it still retains its essence and will grant strength to whoever consumes it, at the cost of some longevity. It is dropped by tornadoes, mimics, and werewolves.

General Balance

Sky tornadoes now deal damage when dragging you (less frequently) and can no longer be used to descend to the mid-plane, only to attack.
Inhabitants of the outer layers (dwarves and elves) will no longer pay you gold for gems or feathers, now they will only buy cursed fangs.
The flute now attracts more types of monsters.
You can now retrieve the watch used to stop time, which resumes normal time but allows you to reuse the item.
NPCs that had 1 HP now have 2.


Config Menu
Pressing ESC brings up a menu to manage game resolution, music, and sound effects, and shows the keyboard controls.

NPC Portraits
A small visual addition alongside text boxes to give a bit of personality and differentiate when an NPC is talking.

Library Changes
A third section has been added to the library, Seasons! It includes 7 new books with details on terrain changes, creatures, and tips for each season in Dungeon World. Two old books have also been updated to reorder new game information.

Japanese Translation (v1)
Missing katakana characters have been added.

Controller Support (v1)
There is now native controller support, but it’s not fully integrated with Steam Input (this will be improved in the future). For now, it works if you follow these steps in the given order:
[olist]
Open in your browser: "steam://forceinputappid/2964580"
Turn on and connect your controller
Open the game
[/olist]
If you disconnect your controller or close the game, you may need to repeat these steps.

Thank you for your interest in Dungeon World, and I hope you enjoy the additions in this new version!
